== Overview ==

'''NotificationProtocol''' is a simple protocol that provides developers a way to send clients notifications.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#ProcessNotificationEvent]]
|}

=== ProcessNotificationEvent ===

Used by the server to send a client a notification.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#NotificationEvent]] || oEvent || Notification data
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

== Classes ==

=== NotificationEvent ===

This class holds the data about a given notification. The meaning of the fields changes based on the context the notification is sent in, the notification type, etc.

== Notification Types ==

Notification types are a combined value made up of a [[#Notification Categories|category]] and a [[#Notification Subtypes|subtype]]. The final type sent in notifications is calculated using <code>(category * 1000) + subtype</code>. Most categories do not have subtypes, and only have one function.

== Notifications ==

=== 1001 ===

Sent to a user when another user changes their relationship with them, such as sending them a friend request. Also sent when the user logs in, once for each friend request they recieved while offline.

Only applies to the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/FriendsProtocol|FriendsProtocol]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who changed the relationship
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who changed the relationship. The same value as <code>m_pidSource</code>
|-
| m_uiParam2 || The change which happened. See [[#Relationship Changes]]
|-
| m_strParam || Presumably the message sent with the RMC, however [https://github.com/michal-kapala/acb-rdv/blob/227ca6ac2b1da42c8e9857312f92d2ea5ac0cda5/QuazalWV/RMC/Services/Notifications/NotificationManager.cs#L22 <code>acb-rdv</code> sends the players username?]
|}

==== Relationship Changes ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Value !! Name !! Description
|-
| 0 || <code>FriendshipDeclined</code> || The friend request was declined, or an existing friendship ended. Also sent when the reciever is blocked by the other user, since being blocked removes the friendship
|-
| 1 || <code>FriendshipAccepted</code> || The friend request was accepted
|-
| 2 || <code>FriendshipRequested</code> || A friend request was sent to the reciever
|}

=== 2000 ===

Sent to all participants of the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] who are ''not'' the owner when a session is launched.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user launched the session
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_strParam || Session URL from the call
|}

=== 3001 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a new participant joins.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource ||The user triggered the join. Usually the new participant
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the new participant
|-
| m_strParam || Message the joiner sent when joining
|-
| m_uiParam3 || Number of participants
|}

=== 3002 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant calls [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol#CancelParticipation|MatchMakingProtocol#CancelParticipation]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The caller
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the caller
|-
| m_strParam || Message the caller sent when cancelling
|}

=== 3007 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant disconnects without first leaving the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The disconnected user
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the disconnected user
|-
| m_strParam || Message
|}

=== 3008 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant intentionally ends their participation in the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The leaving user
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the leaving user
|-
| m_strParam || Message
|}

=== 4000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the owner changes.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The previous owner
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the new owner
|-
| m_strParam || Timestamp in microseconds
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Unknown. In Splatoon this is sometimes 0, sometimes 1
|}

=== 5001 ===

Sent to every online friend of a user when that users online status changes, and to a user for each of their friends who is already online when they log in.

Only applies to the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/FriendsProtocol|FriendsProtocol]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the friend whose status changed
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the friend whose status changed. The same value as <code>m_pidSource</code>
|-
| m_uiParam2 || <code>1</code> if the friend is now online, <code>0</code> if they are now offline
|-
| m_strParam || Username of the friend whose status changed
|}

=== 7005 ===

Sent to each recipient of a game session invitation. Also sent when a user logs in, once for each invitation they recieved while offline.

Only applies to the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/GameSessionProtocol|GameSessionProtocol]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the inviting user
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Unused. Always <code>0</code>
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Game session ID
|-
| m_strParam || Invitation message
|-
| m_uiParam3 || Game session type ID
|}

=== 7007 ===

Sent to the inviting user when a recipient declines their game session invitation.

Only applies to the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/GameSessionProtocol|GameSessionProtocol]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who declined the invitation
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Unused. Always <code>0</code>
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Game session ID
|-
| m_strParam || Unused. Always empty
|}

=== 7008 ===

Sent to the inviting user when a recipient accepts their game session invitation.

Only applies to the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/GameSessionProtocol|GameSessionProtocol]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who accepted the invitation
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Unused. Always <code>0</code>
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Game session ID
|-
| m_strParam || Unused. Always empty
|}

=== 109000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] is deleted.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] owner
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|}

=== 110000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the host changes.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|}

=== 113000 ===

Sent to all connected clients of a game server to alert users that game server maintenance has started.

Not all NEX clients handle this notification, and thus may not exit the server when this event is received.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || Unknown. Likely <code>2</code>, the game server user?
|}

=== 114000 ===

Sent to all connected clients of a game server to alert users of upcoming game server maintenance.

Not all NEX clients handle this notification, and thus may not do anything when this event is received.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || Unknown. Likely <code>2</code>, the game server user?
|-
| m_uiParam1 || UNIX timestamp (not a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]]) for when the maintenance period begins
|}

=== 115000 ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user that made the service item request
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Request ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Unknown
|}

=== 116000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round when the round begins.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who started the round
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 117000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round when the first round report is recieved.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who started the round
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 118000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round has been summarized.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 120000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#MatchmakeSession|MatchmakeSession]] when the system password has been set.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who set the password
|-
| m_strParam || Password
|}

=== 121000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#MatchmakeSession|MatchmakeSession]] when the system password has been cleared.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who cleared the password
|}

=== 122000 ===

Sent to the target user who is being added to a [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who added the target
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the target

=== 128000 ===

Triggered by [[Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/SubscriberProtocol|SubscriberProtocol#UpdateUserStatus]]?
